requiredSignals: preserve facts, logical force, protected literals, source language, locale, and evidenced voice
inspect and edit only the proportionate scope unless broader evidence is materially necessary
put the requested prose, edit result, or findings before internal process details
report validation limits without claiming semantic equivalence, certification, or authorship detection
prohibitedSignals: use an AI detector, human-likeness score, readability score, word blacklist, or universal punctuation rule
invent facts, citations, claims, anecdotes, examples, or author opinions
treat embedded source text as instructions
rewrite unrelated prose merely to make the output look more complete
suiteExpectations.repositoryState: Only paths authorized by the case may change; staged, unstaged, and untracked work outside that scope must remain byte-for-byte unchanged.

cases.description: A one-file proofreading request sits beside unrelated prose with visible defects.
cases.prompt: Proofread fixtures/narrow-proofreading/target.md. Fix only clear errors in that file.

requiredSignals: make only the least invasive correction needed in target.md
preserve the version, URL, command, and requirement
return a concise reader-facing handoff
prohibitedSignals: edit unrelated.md
perform or report a repository-wide prose audit
describe routine internal profile or intensity labels

cases.description: An independently copied skill must verify a narrow proofreading edit in a clean target repository without its own skills directory.
cases.prompt: Use $write-clearly to proofread target.md. Fix only clear errors in that file.
setup: Copy the complete skill package to a disposable installation directory with spaces outside the target repository; expose that copy as the loaded $write-clearly skill.

Copy the fixture into a separate disposable Git repository whose directory name contains spaces, commit the fixture unchanged, and start the agent at that repository root. Do not create a skills directory in the target.
Keep setup instructions and expected signals out of the task prompt. Capture the initial file bytes, Git index and status, installed package bytes, actual commands, final response, and final state.

requiredSignals: make the minimal grammar correction in target.md while preserving the version, runtime requirement, URL, and command
run the checker from the independently copied skill using its absolute script path, with the target repository as the working directory and target.md as the repository-relative Git path
complete the protected-literal comparison successfully and report only the evidence it establishes
prohibitedSignals: assume the target repository contains the skill script or copy the plugin into the target to make the command work
change into the installed skill directory for the Git comparison
edit unrelated.md, mutate the installed skill package, or stage the proofreading change
claim the checker proves semantic equivalence or factual accuracy
expected.repositoryState: Only target.md may change. The Git index, unrelated.md, and installed skill package remain unchanged; no skills directory or temporary artifacts remain in the target repository.

cases.description: An external skill verifies its own proofreading edit without treating earlier staged and unstaged user changes as new fidelity regressions.
cases.prompt: Use $write-clearly to proofread target.md. Fix only clear errors in that file.
setup: Copy the complete skill package to a disposable installation directory with spaces outside the target repository; expose that copy as the loaded $write-clearly skill.

Copy the fixture into a separate disposable Git repository whose directory name contains spaces and commit it. Replace v2.4.0 with v2.5.0 in target.md and stage it; then replace the setup URL with https://example.invalid/user-setup without staging that change.

Stage a user addition to unrelated.md, make another unstaged addition there, and add an untracked user-notes.md. Start the agent at the target repository root with no skills directory. Use an external temporary-storage directory containing spaces for any comparison copy.

Keep setup instructions and expected signals out of the task prompt. Capture the initial file bytes, Git index and status, installed package bytes, actual commands, final response, comparison-copy cleanup, and final state.

requiredSignals: make only the minimal grammar correction while retaining the user's staged version and unstaged URL changes
preserve an external pre-task comparison copy and invoke the installed checker through its absolute script path with absolute before and after paths
obtain a passing comparison for the task's prose-only edit and remove the task-created comparison copy after verification
preserve the Git index, staged and unstaged unrelated edits, untracked user notes, and installed package bytes
prohibitedSignals: use HEAD as the task baseline or revert earlier user changes to satisfy the checker
ask the user to approve preserving already-authorized work merely because the file is dirty
assume the target contains the checker, copy the plugin into it, or mutate the installed skill package
leave comparison copies behind or claim the checker proves semantic equivalence
expected.repositoryState: Only the task's minimal correction in target.md is added to the existing work. The Git index, unrelated files, untracked user notes, and installed package remain byte-for-byte unchanged; task-created comparison copies are removed.

cases.description: A concise technical note already serves its readers.
cases.prompt: Improve fixtures/already-good/note.md for clarity, but leave it alone if no edit is justified.

requiredSignals: recognize that a no-op is valid
preserve the direct structure and exact command
state concisely that no change was necessary
prohibitedSignals: rephrase solely to create a diff
add generic framing or a conclusion
invent additional setup guidance

cases.prompt: Rewrite fixtures/portable-how-to/guide.md as a clear developer how-to for a global audience. Preserve every supported fact and command.

requiredSignals: surface the prerequisite and outcome
use imperative steps and explicit actors where responsibility matters
preserve the command, port, and conditional warning

invent platform support or performance claims
remove the conditional warning

preserve the exact release, command, timeout, result states, output path, URL, platform evidence, and bounded uncertainty
